notes_for_editor: Identity unknown. The OSM way (1477386021) carries name Wilson Tower, emergency=fire_lookout and tower:type=observation, but no ownership, height or date. No register, Forest Service or news source found for a Wilson Tower at these coordinates. Two web searches (Siskiyou and Shasta-Trinity; Wilson Mountain). Search results surfaced other places named Wilson Mountain or Mount Wilson (Los Angeles County, Arizona, Virginia) and Shasta-Trinity lookouts (Girard Ridge, Little Mt. Hoffman, Hirz Mountain) that do not carry the Wilson name. The name may be local or informal. A human could check the Klamath and Shasta-Trinity ranger districts or search for a nearby peak name.
